title: Define deterministic work leases and agent claims
goal: Define a strict lightweight lease/claim registry so only one active agent owns a mutable work unit at a time and stale claims expire deterministically.
inputs: active work graph and strict manifests
invariants: Git and CI reality outrank cached coordination state
coordination metadata never authorizes product-runtime behavior
a stale agent cannot silently overwrite a valid newer claim
recovery avoids repeating expensive verified work when evidence is still valid
security_properties: lease and journal inputs are untrusted data and strictly validated
agent identity is opaque coordination metadata, not an authentication credential
recovery never force-pushes or rewrites Git history

performance_budget.rationale: coordination must reduce recovery/context cost rather than dominate ordinary development
metrics: coordination checks remain metadata-scale and PR-suitable

rollback.strategy: revert the E7 unit while retaining verified E0-E6 controls

definition_of_done: claim IDs and agent IDs are unique opaque identifiers
one work unit has at most one non-expired active lease
blocked or terminal work units cannot be newly claimed
stale claims do not block safe continuation
